segments.text: Creative projects, romance and any risk you take with money come back into play, while the pull of friendships, networks and easy gains is set to loosen, with daily workload and routines carrying the strain between them. Because Rahu sits in a trine from Mercury, whose period will be running then, the reaching-out should work with the main current rather than against it. The Brihat Jataka ties Saturn in Capricorn, whose results Rahu gives here, to taking charge of a group or a locality, as head of a town or a team

sources.text: A person born with Saturn in sign Capricorn or Aquarius will enjoy the wives and property of other men, will be the head of a town, a village or an army,

segments.text: Your career and public role, your home and your closest partnerships are set to widen together, since Jupiter sits in the house of work and rules those of home and marriage. Its neighbouring, slightly awkward pull from Mercury means growth comes through adjusting rather than gliding. The Brihat Jataka links this placement to comfort, a full household, plenty of friends and advisory standing
, counts a sibling as a source of wealth
, and holds that Jupiter's gaze on your Moon lends you the bearing of someone with standing

sources.text: A person born with Jupiter in sign Gemini or Virgo will have many clothes, houses, servants, sons and friends, will be a minister and will live in comfort.
[A person gets wealth from his] brother [according as the planet which occupies the 10th house from the Lagna or from the Moon is] Jupiter
[If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy sign Aquarius] if aspected by Jupiter, he will resemble a King;

segments.text: Around your Saturn return, the pull fell on study, creative work and romance on one side, and on workload, competition and debts on the other, as Saturn went back over the very houses it occupies and rules. Because it arrived inside Saturn's own long period, the review felt doubled: what you had built in learning, love and daily labour was weighed with no outside planet softening it. The Brihat Jataka ties Saturn in Capricorn to lasting wealth, real authority and enjoying property you acquired yourself

sources.text: [A person born with Saturn in sign Capricorn or Aquarius] will have a permanent wealth and authority and will enjoy the property acquired by him.

segments.text: When Mercury took over, the weight shifted to how you present yourself, your career and public role, and the teachers, beliefs and wider horizons that shape both. Mercury sits in a trine from Saturn and is its natural friend, so the handover ran smoothly, carrying Saturn's hard-won discipline into visible work. The Brihat Jataka links this Mercury to steady earning, generosity and respect for a mentor
, while the translator's notes credit a Virgo rising with pleasant speech and a bright presence
and with comfortable means kept carefully

sources.text: A person born with Mercury in sign Taurus or Libra will be a preacher, will have many sons and wives, will ever be engaged in earning money, will be liberal in gift and will respect his preceptor.

segments.text: Your Jupiter return, from May 2025 into 2026, widened matters of home and property, close partnership and contracts, and once more your standing at work. Jupiter sits next to Mercury in the sign order, so it tugged sideways at the new Mercury period, pulling attention toward home and partner while career stayed in focus. The Brihat Jataka gives the Sun–Jupiter pairing a mixed reading, a hard edge and working under others
, though the translator's notes see earnest effort, favour with someone with standing and wealth
